acc.autotag.replace_body: The document already has tags. Automatic tagging replaces them with new ones made from the pages.
acc.clear.body: The structure of the document and its tags are removed. The content of the pages stays as it is.
acc.clear.title: Remove the tags?
acc.explain.alt_content: Alternate text belongs to an element with content on the page.
acc.explain.alt_hides_annot: Alternate text on an element that holds an annotation hides the annotation from screen readers.
acc.explain.bookmarks: Documents of more than 20 pages need bookmarks to move around. Fix: make bookmarks from the headings.
acc.explain.contrast: Check that text and its background have enough contrast to be read by people with low vision.
acc.explain.encoding: Fonts must say which characters they draw so the text can be read and copied.
acc.explain.field_descriptions: Form fields need a description (tooltip) that says what to enter. Fix: make descriptions from the field names.
acc.explain.figures_alt: Figures need alternate text that says what they show, or must be marked as decoration. Fix: write the alternate text.
acc.explain.flicker: Content must not flicker in a way that can cause seizures.
acc.explain.heading_nesting: Headings go down one level at a time (H1, then H2, then H3).
acc.explain.image_only: A document made only of pictures of pages has no text to read: it needs text recognition first.
acc.explain.language: The language of the document tells screen readers how to pronounce its text. Fix: choose the language.
acc.explain.list_items: List items (LI) belong to a list (L).
acc.explain.list_lbl_body: Labels and bodies of list items (Lbl, LBody) belong to a list item (LI).
acc.explain.logical_order: Check in the Order pane that the content is read in the order a person would read it.
acc.explain.multimedia: Sound and video need tags and text alternatives such as captions.
acc.explain.navigation_links: Links that move around the document must not be repeated in a way that gets in the way.
acc.explain.nested_alt: Alternate text inside an element that has its own is never read.
acc.explain.permission: The security settings of the document must let assistive technology read its content.
acc.explain.scripts: Scripts must not get in the way of keyboards and assistive technology.
acc.explain.tab_order: Pages with annotations should move between them in the order of the structure. Fix: set the tab order to follow the structure.
acc.explain.table_cells: Header and data cells (TH, TD) belong to a table row (TR).
acc.explain.table_headers: Tables need header cells (TH) so their data can be understood.
acc.explain.table_regular: Every row of a table has the same number of cells, or cells say how many rows and columns they span.
acc.explain.table_rows: A table row (TR) belongs to a table, a table head, body or foot.
acc.explain.table_summary: Tables need a summary that says what they contain.
acc.explain.tagged: Tags describe the structure of the document (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, figures) and the order to read it in. Fix: tag the document automatically.
acc.explain.tagged_annotations: Comments, links and form fields must have tags so they are read in place. Fix: tag the annotations.
acc.explain.tagged_content: Everything a page draws must be in a tag or be marked as an artifact (decoration). Use the Order pane or create tags from a selection.
acc.explain.tagged_fields: Each form field needs a Form tag. Fix: tag the form fields.
acc.explain.timed: People must have enough time to answer anything that waits for them.
acc.explain.title: The document needs a title, shown in the title bar instead of the file name. Fix: use the first heading or the file name.
acc.language.hint: A language code such as en-US or it-IT: screen readers use it to pronounce the text.
acc.language.label: Primary language
acc.language.title: Document language
acc.no_check: Check the document to see how it does against the accessibility rules.
acc.no_report: The report shows the results of the accessibility check.
acc.no_tags: The document has no tags. Tags give screen readers the structure and the reading order of the document.
acc.report.save: Save the report as a web page
acc.report.summary: Passed: {passed} · Failed: {failed} · Needs manual check: {manual} · Skipped: {skipped}
acc.report.title: Accessibility report
acc.rule.title: Title
alt.decorative: Decorative figure (becomes an artifact, not read aloud)
alt.no_preview: No preview: the figure has no content on the pages
content.untagged_note: Some content of this page is outside tags and artifacts: screen readers skip it or read it out of order.
order.empty: Nothing on this page has a tag.
order.hint: The numbers on the page show the reading order. Move items with the arrows to change it.
tags.area_hint: The content drawn in the selected area goes into the new tag; content that already has a tag moves to it.
tags.classmap_hint: Classes and their attributes, written as Key=Value with spaces between them (O=Layout Placement=Block). A semicolon starts another attribute dictionary.
tags.more: More tags are not shown: close some to see the rest.
tags.not_marked: The document is not marked as tagged.
tags.rolemap_hint: Tags that are not standard types and the standard types they stand for.
tags.title: Title
